title: Conditional first-passage Poisson bridge fixes the boundary-decay target

Check the exact fixture z=6, eta=1, t=1/3, base=2 and distance d=10 in independent SymPy and Fraction lanes.

finding: Primary passes 20/20 and independent passes 19/19, the integrated lane passes 25/25 and Lean R212 passes.
